tasks.title: Call an HTTP endpoint and parse JSON
tasks.script:
import json
import urllib2

req = urllib2.Request('https://example.internal/api/builds')
response = urllib2.urlopen(req)
payload = json.loads(response.read())
for build in payload['builds']:
    print 'found build %s' % build['id']

from java.util import Date

fmt = SimpleDateFormat('yyyy-MM-dd')
